title: Making Tensor Decoupling More Robust and Less Parametric
abstract: arXiv:2610.16937v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tensor decoupling algorithms recover compact representations of multivariate functions by combining linear factor matrices with univariate internal nonlinearities. We identify two limitations of recent methods. First, their performance is not invariant to mismatched output or gradient magnitudes, and second, their spline internals require manual tuning of their degrees of freedom. We propose two lightweight fixes. The first is a preprocessing step that rescales the input Jacobian tensor, removing both the bias towards larger magnitude outputs and the ill-conditioning of certain factor updates caused by such a mismatch. The second replaces B-spline internals by penalized splines coupled with generalized cross-validation, making the method less dependent on the user selecting the right number of control points. Finally, we release an efficient open-source JAX implementation of our algorithm.

translated_title: 让张量解耦更稳健且参数更少
translated_abstract: 张量解耦算法通过将线性因子矩阵与单变量内部非线性相结合，恢复多元函数的紧凑表示。我们指出了近期方法的两个局限性：首先，其性能对输出或梯度幅值的失配不具备不变性；其次，其样条内部结构需要手动调节自由度。我们提出了两个轻量级的改进方案。第一个是一个预处理步骤，对输入雅可比张量进行重新缩放，既消除了对较大幅值输出的偏差，也解决了这种失配导致的某些因子更新的病态问题。第二个方案用结合广义交叉验证的惩罚样条替代B样条内部结构，使方法不再依赖于用户选择正确数量的控制点。最后，我们发布了该算法的高效开源JAX实现。
tldr: 该论文提出两个轻量级改进——通过重缩放输入雅可比张量消除幅值失配带来的偏差与病态问题，并用结合广义交叉验证的惩罚样条替代B样条——使张量解耦方法更稳健且减少了对参数调节的依赖。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes two lightweight fixes for tensor decoupling—rescaling the input Jacobian tensor to remove magnitude-mismatch bias and ill-conditioning, and replacing B-spline internals with penalized splines coupled with generalized cross-validation—making the method more robust and less dependent on manual parameter tuning.
